Relatively safer day Relatively safer night

In detail

Derbyshire Constabulary recorded 246 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 6.5 per 1,000 residents, the 13th highest rate of Derby's 17 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (3), drugs (3), burglary (3); the evening/night score by violent crime (38), anti social behaviour (14), public order (4). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Spondon safe?

Wandroz currently rates Spondon in Derby as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Derby, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from Derbyshire Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Spondon safe at night?

At night, Spondon is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Derby. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Spondon a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Spondon's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Derby) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.
